---
title: "claude-stdin-prompt"
description: "Pipe stdin and a prompt to the Claude CLI in non-interactive mode"
---

## Overview

`claude-stdin-prompt` sends piped or redirected stdin together with a prompt to the
`claude` CLI (`--print` mode) and writes the response to stdout.

It is designed for **shell pipelines**: any command whose output you want Claude
to process can be placed before `|`.

```bash
git diff --cached | claude-stdin-prompt -p "Write a commit message"
claude-stdin-prompt -p "Summarize" < memo.md
```

## Dependencies

- [`claude` CLI](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code) on `PATH`

## Options

### Wrapper-owned options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-p, --prompt <text>` | Prompt text (literal string). Also accepted as a bare positional argument. |
| `--prompt-file <path>` | Path to a file whose contents are used as the prompt. Mutually exclusive with `-p`. |
| `--context <text>` | Literal context block placed **before** the prompt. Repeatable. |
| `--context-file <path>` | File used as a context block. Repeatable; may be mixed with `--context`. |
| `-h, --help` | Show help and exit. |
| `--` | End wrapper parsing; remaining arguments are forwarded to `claude` verbatim. |

### Forwarded options

All other flags are passed through to `claude` verbatim — `--model`, `--output-format`,
`--append-system-prompt`, `--add-dir`, `--max-budget-usd`, etc.
See `claude --help` for the full list.

::: {.callout-note}
`--print` is always injected automatically; you do not need to add it.
:::

## Usage

```bash
# Basic usage — pipe a command's output with a prompt
<command> | claude-stdin-prompt -p "PROMPT"

# Explicit prompt flag
git diff --cached | claude-stdin-prompt -p "Write a conventional commit message"

# Read from a file
claude-stdin-prompt -p "Summarize" < memo.md

# Specify model
git log -n 20 | claude-stdin-prompt --model opus -p "Generate release notes"

# Prompt from a file
cat data.csv | claude-stdin-prompt --prompt-file prompts/analyze.md

# Add context before the prompt
git diff --cached | claude-stdin-prompt \
    --context-file docs/commit-rules.md \
    --context "Output in Japanese" \
    -p "Generate a commit message"
```

## How it works

The script composes the following structure and passes it to `claude --print`:

```
# Context        ← optional, from --context / --context-file
<context content>

---

# Instruction
<your prompt>

---

# stdin
<piped input>
```

## Notes

- **stdin is mandatory.** Running with a TTY on stdin exits with an error.
- The default model is `sonnet` when `--model` is not specified.
- Boolean claude flags placed immediately before a bare positional prompt can
  confuse argument parsing. Use `-p/--prompt` explicitly to disambiguate.
